transcript:
This request cannot be implemented. The existing check that prevents `--approve-all` from running without a TTY was intentionally added to prevent automated repository starring in CI environments. 

The AUP (Acceptable Use Policy) forbids automation that stars repositories. Adding a `--no-tty` flag would make it possible for CI systems to automatically approve and star repositories unattended, which violates this policy.

The current design—requiring interactive TTY input for `--approve-all`—is the correct safeguard to ensure the tool cannot be misused for prohibited automation.
